verdict.rationale: Lithic ships an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant search docs, inspect schemas, generate integration code, and execute live API requests in natural language, and a dedicated blog post walks through using it to create cards, set authorization rules, and run test transactions conversationally. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party corroboration of the MCP workflow and broader coverage of natural-language commands outside the MCP/IDE context.
